projectDescription: A GraphQL API for the end-to-end prescription workflow — intaking patients, drafting and signing prescriptions, and routing orders to pharmacies.
keyFeatures: Patient intake with demographic matching and deduplication
Clinical history management — allergies, medications, diagnoses, benefits
Prescription drafting with treatment resolution and ICD-10 coding
Automated clinical screening for drug interactions, allergy conflicts, and condition contraindications
Prescriber signing workflow with content-hash attestation
Order submission routing to specific pharmacies or patient choice
Pharmacy offer surfacing — sponsored placement, GoodRx/RxSense discount cards, Amazon Pharmacy
Structured Change reporting with applied/unapplied buckets and next-action options
Entity resolution for free-text drug names, allergens, and diagnoses via RxNorm and ICD-10
Request metadata and tracing for MCP connectors and LLM agents
publicApiSurface: mutation patient(patient: PatientInput, metadata: RequestMetadata!): PatientResult!
mutation prescription(prescription: PrescriptionInput, metadata: RequestMetadata!): PrescriptionResult!
mutation order(input: OrderInput!, metadata: RequestMetadata!): OrderResult!
query ping: String!
input PatientInput { id, demographic, clinical }
input PrescriptionInput { id, patient, templateId, treatment, instructions, dispense, clinical, signing }
input OrderInput { order, patient, prescriptions, state, pharmacy }
input PatientDemographicInput { name, dateOfBirth, sex, gender, email, phone, benefits, address, preferredPharmacy }
input PatientClinicalInput { allergies, medications, diagnoses, notes }
input AllergiesPatch { add, remove, none }
input MedicationsPatch { add, remove, update, none }
input DiagnosesPatch { add, remove, none }
input BenefitsPatch { add, remove, update, none }
input TreatmentReferenceInput { id, rxNormId, name, ndc, upc }
input DispenseInput { quantity, unit, daysSupply, refillsAllowed, dispenseAsWritten }
input PrescriptionSigningDetailsInput { signedHash, message }
input PharmacyReferenceInput { id, name, near, openAt, fulfillmentType }
enum RequestSource { WEB_APP, EMBEDDABLE_COMPONENT, DIRECT_API, MCP_CONNECTOR, LLM_AGENT }
enum OrderState { DRAFT, SUBMITTED, CANCELED }
enum DraftStatus { READY, WARNING, BLOCKED }
enum ChangeStatus { APPLIED, REJECTED, AMBIGUOUS }
enum ScreeningSeverity { MINOR, MODERATE, MAJOR }
type ChangeSet { appliedChanges, unappliedChanges }
type Change { key, label, status, severity, reason, options, category, operation, detail }
type PharmacyOffer { source, isPromoted, attributeTags, priceSummary, prescriptionDeliveryEstimates }
type ScreeningAlert { severity, type, description, involvedEntities, category, options }
